correctness.rationale: The exact coordinate graph has 24 vertices, 30 edges, 20 full matchings and 66,369 nonempty simplices. The complete Forman Hasse graph of 420,294 covers admits an explicitly enumerated acyclic matching with 33,183 pairs and critical dimensions (0,3,3), giving S^3 wedge S^3. On each of all twelve exact group permutations two independent signed fixed-face algorithms agree on reduced Lefschetz traces and give the listed rational H3 character. The alpha plus beta decomposition and quotient ranks are exact consequences of semisimplicity and rational transfer; the claim does not extend to other side lengths or integral representations.

value.rationale: The canonical first non-line two-by-two-by-two honeycomb has two known degree-three sphere generators whose symmetry transformation was undetermined in the cited original topology study. Distinct dihedral sign lines explain the nontrivial 60-degree action, trivial 120-degree action and surprisingly different homology of full-dihedral, cyclic and reflection quotients. Unlike a bare Betti-number recomputation, this is an exact natural equivariant invariant of a motivated test case; it is valuable without claiming a general family theorem.
